name: islands-depth
postprocess: cwebp -q 82; the PNG originals stay local in src/
prompt: Tilt-shift photograph of a surreal handmade miniature diorama, shallow depth of field, soft golden morning light from the left. Three small islands of rock and earth with flat grassy tops float at three different distances in a pale hazy sky, high above a miniature Indian town seen far below, with soft clouds drifting between the islands and the town. The nearest island, at the lower left, is the largest: on its grass stands a giant plain orange snack packet with no lettering, upright like a monument, with a tiny corrugated godown, tiny trees and tiny people around its foot. The middle island, right of centre and a little farther away, carries a giant plain white and teal drink carton with no lettering, with a tiny colourful shop and tiny people. The farthest island, small, at the upper right, carries a giant plain glass bottle of golden oil with a blank label, with a tiny warehouse and tiny trees. Thin softly glowing green ribbons of light arc through the air from the foot of each island down to one point on the ground at the lower middle of the frame, where the three ribbons meet. Warm sand, terracotta and sage-green palette against a pale cream sky. No lettering, no words or numbers anywhere, no logos, no faces.
use: Your own workspace: the islands in depth, by day (SC-78 part 3, option A)
